hooks.name: block-main-branch-commits
hooks.message: Direct commits to main are forbidden. Switch to a feature branch first.

hooks.name: block-force-push
hooks.message: Force push is not allowed. Use --force-with-lease and explain why first.

hooks.name: warn-on-env-modification
hooks.message: About to modify env file. Are secrets being touched?

hooks.name: block-package-json-without-discussion
hooks.message: Modifying package.json. Confirm dependency change was discussed.

hooks.name: block-destructive-rm
hooks.message: rm -rf is forbidden. Use git rm or move to /trash/ folder instead.

hooks.name: verify-after-significant-change
hooks.command: npm run typecheck && npm run lint

hooks.name: block-production-db-mutations
hooks.message: Production database mutations are forbidden via agent. User must run manually.

hooks.name: sanity-readonly-default
hooks.message: About to mutate Sanity production. Confirm intent.
